why: The name pattern knew only the dot (`.test.`), and the Python and Go convention writes the separator with an underscore. Measured on 2026-08-30: `VectraB-Lab` was accused of "zero test files" while having three tracked `*_test.py` scripts, among them `02-obd-kline/vectra_kw82_test.py`. It is the same vocabulary blindness that already cost this rule a false positive in Portuguese — 43 files with "prova" in the name and zero seen. Both sides have the SAME module; only the test file beside it changes. `TESTE-1-cabo-KKL.md` from the same repository still does NOT count, and that is why the accepted separator is `_` and not `-`.
